candidates.formal_type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
  [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} Complex V] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm.{0, u_1} Complex V),
  (∀ (x y : V),
      Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} B x) y)
        (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} B y) x)) →
    LinearMap.BilinForm.Nondegenerate.{0, u_1} B →
      ∀ (n : Nat),
        Eq.{1} (Module.finrank.{0, u_1} Complex V) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 n) 1) →
          Exists.{2} fun S =>
            Exists.{1} fun x =>
              Exists.{1} fun x_1 =>
                And (Eq.{1} (Module.finrank.{0, 0} Complex S) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} 2 n))
                  (Nonempty.{max 1 (u_1 + 1)}
                    (AlgEquiv.{0, u_1, 0} Complex (Etingof.Problem3_9_5.CliffAlg.{u_1} B)
                      (Prod.{0, 0} (Module.End.{0, 0} Complex S) (Module.End.{0, 0} Complex S))))

rule: Use primary exactly when the declaration itself states or defines the source claim. Use supporting for prerequisites, constructions, helper lemmas, instances, or consequences that help formalize the item but do not themselves state it.
source_text: If dim V=2n+1 and B is nondegenerate, Cl(V) is End(S)×End(S) with dim S=2^n, hence has exactly two irreducible representations of that dimension.
